rationale: The original short thesis relied on session VWAP ($11.09) and the 5-minute 9-EMA ($11.06) acting as overhead resistance, but the price has reclaimed and held above both levels at $11.24 following a steady sequence of higher lows on the 1-minute chart. Rather than waiting to get stopped out at $11.35 on a wide-spread (106.8 bps) low-float runner, closing now respects the broken technical resistance. Flipping to long is avoided due to the wide bid-ask spread, absence of a news catalyst, and strong broad market headwinds (SPY -1.95%).
